items.title: Lillian De Pass Interview, 1960-06-20
items.q: And about, did you ever know about little Boynell Santiago? Yeah, he was right on it. Yeah, when he played, best of the time, he played with Arnold too, you know, Boynell did.

ctx.x: Yeah, Billy Moreira. Billy, that's right. And there's Eddie and Lawrence and Simon. Billy learned him to be a manager. Billy learned him. Because often, I would have had some of them contracts to show you, because I used to still keep them, still keep them. Well, it really got away after. Instead of cheering, my oldest girl, she'd just get along some things, and she'd say, Mama, what do you want this? This is junk. I had contracts that I used to sign. Say, for instance, they play a ball for Carnival tonight.…
Well, Lester still plays, that brother. Huh? Lester Santiago still plays. Oh, yeah. Black, huh?
